title: [master] Exporting the VAT Report using the new ELMA XML export the report status remains 'Released' instead of changing to 'Exported' in the German version.
summary: Fixed a bug where the VAT report status remained 'Released' instead of changing to 'Exported' when exporting via ELMA XML format in the German version.
key_points: VAT report export status was not updating correctly in German localization
Issue occurred when using the new ELMA XML export format
Status should change from 'Released' to 'Exported' after export
Fix applied to VAT Report Export codeunit
Test coverage added for the fix
